specs.title: onboarding in pounds and feet-inches, all seven one-tap habits from the dashboard, celebration, correction and calendar
offline optimistic writes, reconnect deduplication and manual fallback when the estimate fails
camera capture reaches a correctable estimate in four actions without storing the image
a tap changes state in under 100 ms and shifts no layout, with every habit animated distinctly
walking moves the marker along the hero path and eating animates the bowl
reduced motion disables every animation and transition on every page
rest in one tap with undo, two per week, planned ahead; backfill, rescue, targets and trends
no horizontal scroll, drag or overflow on any page at 390x844; vertical scroll only inside the page
no horizontal scroll, drag or overflow on any page at 375x640; vertical scroll only inside the page
no horizontal scroll, drag or overflow on any page at 1280x900; vertical scroll only inside the page
water goes down by one tap with no dialog, and never below zero
nothing transient appears and nothing shifts on a habit tap, a pour, a meal or a removal
the served manifest, icons and splash carry the My Wellness name and the brand art
every page is one tap from the dashboard, has an obvious Home, and the browser back button works
the walk timer starts, pauses, survives a reload and a long sleep, finishes into a logged session, and undoes
the workout page is a checklist with a session clock, an editable plan, and a finish that records the moves
the guided ab routine walks through timed intervals with instructions and logs itself at the end
meditation and focus are optional: they log minutes and never change the streak
treats are user-chosen, cost points, refuse when short, redeem once per tap, and undo
units switch between lb/ft-in and kg/cm without changing the stored measurement; weigh-ins convert on entry
local midnight rolls the day over; a timer started before midnight credits the day it began
a rest day yesterday keeps the streak across midnight where a miss would have broken it
backfilling a past day from Progress opens the activity pages in backfill mode
milestones show reached streaks and the next one
keyboard: tabbing reaches every control in order with a visible focus ring, and Enter logs
text contrast meets WCAG AA on every page
a running timer is visible from the dashboard and a duplicate finish cannot log twice
logging from the dashboard while a timer runs finishes that session with its time and ticks; undo removes the session
a timer left from another day is offered for that day or discarded, never silently backfilled
finished timers settle from any page: a meditation ends while the dashboard is open, a focus session caps itself
re-saving your details without touching height or weight keeps the exact stored measurements
in backfill mode the workout checklist is read-only and no timer starts
the hero opens whatever comes next, and water and meals undo from the dashboard in one tap
half a Stanley is exactly 15 oz, twice; the fill and the daily total match; refills, ambiguity and the model fallback behave
containers are hers to name and size, in her unit, and the default drives the one-tap
B1: a malformed change never strands the queue: the account refuses it by id, the valid change lands, the user sees it and can discard it after a reload
B1: ordinary input cannot queue a refused change: treats, plan lines and estimate totals are bounded in the form
B2: a re-save keeps exact stored measurements only for untouched fields; a one-centimetre or a tenth-of-a-pound edit is taken as typed
B3: the sound switch and the sheet dialogs have accessible names
two tabs settling the same meditation credit it once
optional timers cannot be started for a past day
H1: hero and stage copy, chips and pills never overlap, at phone and short-phone sizes
Floss has the same shape as the other activities: a primary Mark flossed, then a logged card with Undo
R1: two focus sessions on one day credit 25 + 25 = 50 minutes, after a reload and after an offline replay
R4: a walk left running for 26 hours finishes as a 24-hour session; the timer clears only once the change is accepted
R3: a slow sync in one tab cannot erase a change another tab queued meanwhile
R2: a pour from a long-named container logs with a trimmed label, and a refusal shows at the action
R-extra: switching the weight unit after typing does not reinterpret the number; a refused queued change does not block unlock
R163-1: when device storage refuses the write, an automatically finishing timer and a manual finish both keep their timer and retry once storage is back
R163-2: a refused batch during a slow sync cannot overwrite a change another tab queued and then closed on
R163-3: an in-form unit toggle keeps untouched measurements exact
R163-4: a change written by another tab exactly between this tab's read and its save survives, because every change has its own durable key
non-text contrast: unchecked workout rings, the off and on switch, unit segments and unreached milestone labels meet 3:1 with inherited opacity applied
a live session keeps its controls in the first viewport at phone, small and desktop sizes
the water target is shown and edited in her volume unit and an untouched field keeps the exact millilitres
R163-5: an offline start replays a change that only the journal holds, shows it once, and the account receives it once
R163-6: when the journal key itself is refused, the change is not applied, a notice is shown on the page, and a finishing timer is kept
R163-7: a change the account refuses in tab A is kept by id when tab B's slow sync saves afterwards, survives a reload, and an explicit discard stays discarded in both tabs
R163-8: tab A's refusal survives A closing and tab B saving a new change before B's slow sync answers; B's explicit discard then holds through its own later saves and a reload
